name: papersnap
description: Local, in-browser PDF toolkit - React + TypeScript SPA

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/csp-hash.mjs && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.build:pages: tsc -b && vite build --base=/PaperSnap/ && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/csp-hash.mjs && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
